plotting_plan.title: Shared Backbone with a Single Attention Insertion Point
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Block Diagram) of the shared CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 basic block, showing the attention module A applied to the residual branch after the second batch normalisation and before the residual addition, with the identity shortcut bypassing A, and the four interchangeable settings of A (none, SE, BAM, CBAM).

plotting_plan.title: Accuracy Degradation Across Corruption Severity
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Line Chart with Error Bars) plotting mean corruption accuracy against severity 0 through 5 for all four arms, with across-seed standard deviation as error bars, demonstrating whether the arms degrade at different rates and whether their lines cross.

plotting_plan.title: Relative Robustness Drop by Arm
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Bar Chart with Error Bars) of the relative robustness drop per arm with across-seed standard deviation, normalising out each arm's clean starting point so that an arm beginning lower is not misread as more robust.

plotting_plan.title: Per-Corruption-Type Accuracy Breakdown
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Grouped Bar Chart) of mean accuracy per corruption type per arm, averaged over severities and seeds, exposing whether the four-type mean hides a type-specific skew that would flatter or punish spatial attention.

plotting_plan.title: Ranking Stability from Clean to Severity Five
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Bump/Slope Chart) of each arm's rank position at clean and at each corruption severity, so that any reordering between the clean ranking and a corrupted ranking is directly readable as a crossing line.

introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Channel and spatial attention blocks are among the cheapest and most widely reused architectural additions in computer vision, and practitioners select among them on the clean-accuracy numbers their original papers report.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: Those numbers are collected under conditions a deployed classifier never reproduces, and no paper in this method family reports whether the ordering they induce survives common image corruptions, even though a corruption benchmark sharing the same label space and resolution is freely available and requires inference only.
search_directions: Find highly cited foundational papers establishing channel and spatial attention as standard CNN components and the accuracy gains they report
Search for published surveys of attention mechanisms in convolutional neural networks that summarise the evaluation metrics used across the family
Identify foundational papers establishing corruption robustness benchmarking as a standard evaluation axis for image classifiers
Find highly cited work documenting the real-world impact of distribution shift and common corruptions on deployed vision models
Identify papers arguing that single-metric benchmark rankings can be misleading or fail to transfer to deployment conditions

related_work_strategy.overview: Investigate three paradigms to establish that the compared attention blocks are evaluated on clean accuracy alone, that corruption robustness is an established and orthogonal evaluation axis, and that no existing work audits this specific method family under one matched training protocol.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Identify the canonical channel-attention and channel-plus-spatial-attention blocks, the backbones they were validated in, and the exact set of metrics each reports.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Every paper in this cluster reports clean top-1 and top-5 accuracy, and detection mAP where applicable, but none reports any robustness or distribution-shift metric, so the ordering these papers induce has never been tested off the clean distribution.

content_bullets: Open with the Problem Statement from idea.md: attention blocks are compared almost exclusively on clean test accuracy, and one of them positions itself as an improvement over another on precisely that basis.
State the deployment mismatch: sensors blur, illumination drifts, contrast collapses, and the practitioner's selection metric was collected under conditions the deployment does not reproduce.
Sharpen the question from 'do attention blocks help' to 'is the ordering they induce on clean data the ordering that survives corruption'.

Name the two confounds from idea.md that prevent the existing literature from answering: per-paper backbones and budgets, and the shared repository and insertion convention that two of the three blocks inherit while the third does not.

State the Core Hypothesis from idea.md: spatial attention maps depend on local structure that defocus blur and contrast reduction attack directly, so a spatial gate may degrade faster than a channel-only gate.
Pre-commit to the null being equally reportable, exactly as idea.md frames it, so the reader knows the outcome was not selected after the fact.

List the four Expected Contributions from idea.md as a bulleted list: the matched-budget single-backbone comparison, the ranking-stability result, the provenance record including the BAM paper-versus-code fusion discrepancy, and the practical selection guidance.
Close with a roadmap of the remaining sections.

subsections.subsection_title: 3.1 Shared Backbone and a Single Insertion Point
content_bullets: Formalise the backbone from the Proposed Methodology of idea.md: a CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 with a 3x3 stride-1 stem and no initial max-pool, four stages of two basic blocks at widths 64, 128, 256 and 512, global average pooling, and a linear classifier, grounded in model.py under experiments/attention-robustness/code/.
State the residual-branch equation from idea.md, out = relu(A(BN2(conv2(relu(BN1(conv1(x)))))) + shortcut(x)), and define A as the attention module under test or the identity for the baseline arm.
Argue the confound control: because A is the only varying term, a measured difference is attributable to the module rather than to placement, host architecture, or training recipe.

State the cost of this choice honestly, as the Decisions subsection of experimental_log.md records: no arm reproduces its own paper's placement, so absolute accuracies are not comparable to published numbers and none is claimed.
Report the parameter counts from experimental_log.md: none 11.17M, SE 11.26M, BAM 11.36M, CBAM 11.26M, showing the arms differ only by attention parameters.

content_bullets: Give the channel-only formulation from idea.md: global average pool to z, then s equals sigma of W2 delta W1 z with W1 in R to the C over r by C, then channel-wise rescale, with r equal to 16.

State that this is the study's single reimplementation and justify it from the Decisions subsection of experimental_log.md: the official release of that method is Caffe-only and contains no Python, while the block itself is fully specified by two equations.

State that the other two modules are ported directly from the official public implementation, preserving layer types, pooling choices, bias settings, batch-norm placement and hyperparameters, and bottleneck widths C over r.

Emphasise the first load-bearing detail from idea.md: the two spatial-attention arms use different channel gates, one pooling average statistics only with normalisation between its MLP layers and the other pooling average and max through a shared MLP, and conflating them would partially collapse the contrast the study measures.

Report the second load-bearing detail: the published fusion equation of one module is additive while its official code computes a multiplicative fusion with a residual offset; we follow the code because the code is the artefact the field reuses, and we report the discrepancy rather than resolving it silently.

content_bullets: Explain why fidelity is asserted mechanically rather than by inspection: the comparison's validity rests entirely on the modules being what they claim to be, as the Orchestration Decisions of experimental_log.md record.

Describe the structural assertions and, critically, the behavioural ones from idea.md: one module's output-to-input ratio must lie in the open interval from 1 to 2 as its residual multiplicative form requires, and the other's in the open interval from 0 to 1 as a pure gate requires, so fusion semantics are verified by behaviour rather than by reading source code.
Note that the suite runs before every training installment, grounded in verify_milestones.py under experiments/attention-robustness/code/.

State the datasets from the Setup subsection of experimental_log.md: 50,000 training and 10,000 test images at 32x32 across 10 classes for training and clean evaluation, and the corruption benchmark restricted to four corruption types at severities 1 through 5 with 10,000 images per type and severity.

State the matched training recipe verbatim from the Setup subsection: SGD, learning rate 0.1, momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, batch size 128, cosine annealing, random 32x32 crop with 4-pixel padding and random horizontal flip, identical across all arms.
State the seed set and the resulting number of training runs, and that no arm uses a pretrained or externally obtained checkpoint.
State the precision policy from the Setup subsection: mixed precision for training and full precision for validation, so that checkpoint selection and final evaluation share one numeric path.
State the hardware from the Setup subsection.
